Job Description
 Start your technical support career with Oracle Health’s Direct Care Tier 1 team. You will help healthcare clients troubleshoot the devices, connectivity, and systems that support their daily operations.
As a first point of contact, you will listen to clients, ask thoughtful questions, investigate reported issues, and guide them through established troubleshooting steps. You will work with experienced colleagues to resolve issues and recognize when additional technical expertise is needed.
This entry-level role is suited to someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and learning new technology. Strong communication, curiosity, accountability, and a service-oriented approach are essential. You will build your knowledge of Oracle Health solutions through training, practical experience, and collaboration with the team.
 Required Qualifications
 A degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with clients and colleagues. 
 A logical approach to problem-solving, including the ability to gather information, follow instructions, and recognize when to seek help. 
 Foundational understanding of computer systems, software applications, and basic networking concepts. 
 Strong organization and attention to detail, including accurate written documentation. 
 The ability to remain composed, show empathy, and manage competing priorities in a client support environment. 
 A willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies, accept feedback, and apply new knowledge. 
 Availability to work the schedule outlined below. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 The following experience is helpful; prior hands-on experience with every listed technology is not expected for this entry-level role.
 Experience helping customers or users in technical support, a service desk, customer service, or a similar role. 
 Exposure to Healthcare solutions, electronic health records, connected medical devices, or healthcare workflows. 
 Awareness of healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR. 
 Basic knowledge of SQL or MySQL databases. 
 Exposure to remote troubleshooting tools or incident and service request management systems. 
 Relevant exposure may come from coursework, projects, internships, certifications, or employment.
 Work schedule
 Monday through Friday, aligned with 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time. Working hours in Romania are:
 Standard time: 4:00 PM–1:00 AM EET (following day). 
 Summer/daylight saving time: 4:00 PM–1:00 AM EEST (following day). 
 During the brief periods when U.S. and Romanian daylight saving dates differ, working hours in Romania shift to 3:00 PM–12:00 AM EET. Each shift begins Monday through Friday, with overnight shifts ending the following day.
 Responsibilities
 What you will do
 Provide professional, responsive support through inbound calls, service requests, and client follow-up. 
 Listen carefully and ask focused questions to understand the issue, affected workflow, and impact on the client. 
 Learn to support Oracle Health solutions used for medical device connectivity, laboratory instrument interfaces, clinical communications, and capacity management. 
 Follow approved troubleshooting procedures and use available tools and knowledge resources to investigate issues. 
 Review system information and logs, with guidance as needed, to help identify connectivity, application, and data flow problems. 
 Resolve issues within Tier 1 scope and confirm the outcome with the client. 
 Document symptoms, affected systems and devices, troubleshooting performed, findings, and next steps in service requests. 
 Recognize urgent or widespread issues and promptly engage technical leads or incident management resources according to established procedures. 
 Collaborate with Tier 2 support and other teams, providing a clear summary of the issue and investigation when escalation is needed. 
 Keep clients informed of progress and explain next steps in language they can understand. 
 Manage assigned requests, meet established response expectations, and follow through on commitments. 
 Participate in training, coaching, and knowledge sharing to develop technical and client support skills. 
 Follow established privacy, security, and information-handling requirements. 
 About Us
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute.
